title: ERTS: Adversarial Robustness Testing of Ethical AI via Semantic Perturbation in a Bounded Consequence Space

bias_targets.methodology: Applying 'Fairness Corruption' semantic perturbation attacks that mathematically manipulate 'fairness_impact' and 'discrimination_level' variables within a 22-dimensional Ethical Consequence Space to measure if an AI model's decision flips to a discriminatory outcome.
